newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar ends unchanged in thin trading.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar ends unchanged in thin trading.

text.p: The Canadian dollar ended virtually unchanged from this morning's open at C$1.3705 (US$0.7297), dealers said.
They said trading thinned to a near trickle after the Bank of Canada closed up shop at 1300 EST/1800 GMT.
Traders said the underlying tone for the Canadian dollar remains bullish, but since most investors remain out of the market until next week a real gauge is unlikely to appear until Monday.
The currency market will be closed on Wednesday for the New Year's Day holiday, but will reopen on Thursday.
